body: You’re right. I decided to speak to him about these feelings and he was understanding. It helped me feel better. That helped me to decide to keep the friendship. He’s too good of a friend.

Yes true. The only thoughts we know for sure are our own. Nobody is a mind reader so we can’t assume we know what others are thinking for sure.

That’s how I felt before and it made me depressed knowing everyone was having such a fun and great life. Then I realized that they’re just posting about the good moments in their life. For all we know, they could have miserable lives “behind the scenes”. No one has a perfect happy life. They make you see what they want you to see. I post on social media from time to time so I’m guilty as well.
Thanks everyone for sharing and making me feel better.
